facts.fact: Loi n° 29-2019 of 10 October 2019 on personal data protection, passed by the National Assembly and Senate and promulgated by the President, is published in the Journal officiel of 7 November 2019 (Art. 101); it sets principles, rights and obligations for processing by the State and private bodies.
facts.system: Loi n° 29-2019 du 10 octobre 2019 portant protection des données à caractère personnel

facts.fact: The law defines a commission, created by a separate law, to oversee processing and gives it powers to warn, order, withdraw authorisations and fine from 1 million to 100 million CFA francs (Arts. 92-97), with appeal to the Supreme Court.
